data.case_title: Recognition of your son's school-way accident as a work accident (Arbeitsunfall)
data.title: Recognition of accident as Arbeitsunfall – Unfallkasse Beispiel-Mitte
data.summary: The Unfallkasse Beispiel-Mitte (statutory accident insurance) recognises the bicycle accident of your son Paul on 14 September 2026 on his way to school as a work accident (Arbeitsunfall), and will cover the costs of medical treatment and physiotherapy directly with the practices.
data.explanation: This is a favourable decision: the Unfallkasse confirms your son's fall on his way to school counts as an insured accident, so it will pay the doctors and physiotherapists directly — you don't need to submit any receipts yourself. If you disagree with any part of this decision, you may file an objection (Widerspruch) with the Unfallkasse; the app shows you the deadline for this. If you do nothing, the decision becomes final after that period.
